title: King Tou sends gifts to David
description: When King Tou of Hamat heard that David had defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, he sent his son Hadoram to David to greet him and bless him, bringing articles of gold, silver, and bronze. David dedicated these gifts to the Lord along with the spoils from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and the Amalekites.
